description: Latest crypto news headlines from eight outlets (Cointelegraph, Decrypt, The Block, Bitcoin Magazine, CryptoSlate, The Defiant, CryptoPotato, NewsBTC) in one feed, newest first: title, link, source, time, summary and categories. Optional q filters by keyword or coin (btc matches bitcoin), hours sets the window (default 72), source picks one outlet. Costs $0.001 USDC on Base via x402.

hours.description: Only articles from the last N hours (default 72, up to 720)

q.description: Keyword or coin, comma-separated terms all must match (bitcoin, eth, stablecoin)

name: crypto_news
